column1: > Where every program in the Linux and macOS packages comes from.
> installer/posix/build.py and the redist release workflow read this and nothing
> tag     the published tag, or "-" when the source has never been tagged
> commit  the 40-hex commit that tag resolves to, because a tag can be moved
> Both columns, not one. The tag says which release this is; the commit is what
> the build checks it got. A build that fetches the tag and lands on a different
> A source whose tag is "-" has no release. It is shipped from a commit on a
> branch, and the release notes say so in those words. jobd is that source:
> openabstractions/service-jobd has never carried a tag, checked 2026-09-09 with
> git ls-remote --tags. Nothing here can invent one.
